extraction.policy_summary: The Bank has established an Equal Opportunity Policy in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, providing a structured framework to promote inclusion and empowerment of people with disabilities in the workplace and guidance for addressing disability-related matters in accordance with applicable laws.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: 1,210 permanent differently abled employees reported (951 male, 78.59%; 259 female, 21.40%); differently abled workers reported as 0 / Not Applicable.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Ramps installed across most branches and offices to support mobility of differently abled individuals; most offices equipped with elevators and other necessary infrastructure; few locations offer accessible wheelchairs and restrooms; approximately 75% of the Bank's offices are stated to be accessible to individuals with disabilities, including wheelchair-accessible elevators.
extraction.training_or_sensitization_programs: Programs on Vishaka Guidelines, Gender Sensitivity & Disability inclusion are made available on the Bank's LMS self-learning portal for all employees; a training/workshop on implementation of the GoI reservation policy and accessible services for PWDs is listed among leadership/HR training programs conducted during the year.
extraction.recruitment_details: In line with Government of India guidelines, the Bank provides reservations in direct recruitment for Persons with Disabilities (PWD) alongside SC/ST/OBC categories. No specific numeric hiring target, quota percentage, or attainment figures for PWD recruitment are reported.

evidence.quote: The Bank has established an Equal Opportunity Policy in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ... offering practical guidance for addressing disability-related matters in accordance with applicable laws.

Ramps have been installed to ensure easy access, and most offices are equipped with elevators and other necessary infrastructure ... Approximately 75% of its offices are accessible to individuals with disabilities.
Programs on Vishaka Guidelines, Gender Sensitivity & Disability inclusion are available on LMS the self-learning portal for all employees.

In line with Government of India guidelines, the Bank provides reservations in direct recruitment for Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and Persons with Disabilities (PWD).
